rendered: According to the papers, ethylene glycol does not corrode the aluminum foil during delamination. In fact, the papers state that the aluminum foil is fully recovered without any corrosion after the delamination process. This is shown in Figure 3g and h, which are SEM images of the surface morphology of the recovered aluminum foil, and Figure S3, which is an XRD pattern of the recovered aluminum foil, which shows that all the diffraction peaks can be attributed to aluminum, indicating that the process does not corrode aluminum.
